An '''Imperial Shipyard''' orbited [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. The Shipyards were built in an attempt to increase [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] influence in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and the [[Baxel sector/Legends|Baxel sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and focuses on the production of [[TIE series|TIE]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]].<ref name="LoNH" />

The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] were originally unhappy about the Shipyards, but eventually accepted them because they could sell raw materials to the Empire. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] attempted on multiple occasions to sabotage supply shipments traveling to the Shipyards, but were unsuccessful.<ref name="LoNH" />
